file.download-as.note: ledger row: file.download-as — backstage Download As row opens the export pane; its #btn-export trigger discloses the format menu (setMenu -> #export-sub unhidden, aria-expanded)

file.protect.note: ledger row: file.protect — backstage Protect row opens the protect pane; #btn-fileprotect runs protectDialog() -> #protect-dialog

file.suggest-a-feature.note: ledger row: file.suggest-a-feature — backstage Suggest row opens the suggest pane; #btn-filesuggest runs openDlg("suggest-dialog")

shortcut.save.note: ledger row: shortcut.save — Ctrl+S runs saveDocument(): status cycles Saving -> Saved (fetch POST /api/documents/{id}/save succeeds against the parity docserver)

statusbar.btn-doc-spell.note: ledger row: statusbar.btn-doc-spell — statusbar Spell button toggles the inline spellcheck engine; click flips aria-pressed false->true and syncs the settings checkbox

statusbar.english-united-states.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row statusbar.english-united-states (token sb-lang) — #sb-lang is a passive statusbar label mirrored from the #doc-lang select (syncStatusbarLang); it has NO click handler, so the promised language-picker affordance never appears. The picker only opens via #doc-lang-caret showPicker(), which throws in headless chromium.

statusbar.btn-doc-lang.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row statusbar.btn-doc-lang (token sb-lang, same physical control as statusbar.english-united-states) — #sb-lang has no click listener; clicking never surfaces a language UI.

ctx.actual-size.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.actual-size — the ctx item is data-showif="image" gated (hidden over a text selection, which is the only state the ctx-menu pre can build) and applyObjectOp("actual-size") without a selected object no-ops into Status.NotAvailable.

ctx.print-selection.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.print-selection — the ctx item exists and emits wo-command printSelection; runCommand dispatches the wo:print-selection window event and opens a scratch print window via window.open — the effect lives outside the page DOM (popup target + window event), so no contract assertion kind can observe it.

ctx.rotate.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row ctx.rotate — WO has no Rotate ctx item at all; the census maps the capability to the right-panel #rp-image-rotate (applyImageRotate90), which needs an image selection — state no contract pre can build — so the promised ctx-menu Rotate never appears.
